heldout_selection.rule: Annotation-only, fixed before any checkpoint was scored: per sequence and gap, evenly spaced candidates ranked by the share of tracked objects moving >= 0.5 source diameters (mean displacement breaks ties); top 3 kept. Huh7 has too few annotated frames and is an easy real control.

code.commit_under_test: 6943b77e3 plus merge 4eb5ebcbe (timeflows code unchanged by the merge)

limits: Linking given supplied masks (GT for C. glutamicum, Huh7 and synthetic SIM+; silver ST for U373 and DIC-HeLa), not end-to-end segmentation plus tracking.
Harder here means wider frame gaps chosen for annotated motion: it imitates a sparser acquisition of the same movies, not intrinsically small fast cells, and divisions accumulate inside wide gaps.
Objects in related frames of one movie are not independent biological replicates.
The IoU arm is the timeflows_baseline stitcher; zero motion is the same distance-gated Hungarian matcher given zero vectors, with no model.
decision: Not promoted. v2 does not beat the IoU stitcher on the dense real movie and ties zero motion elsewhere.
